note: v1.3: no fixed skill list. Skills are an open registry: data/skills/<id>.json defines a skill, add a file to add a skill. These 12 are seed examples only, not a cap. Creature files' job-flavoured skill ids (smithing, guarding, etc.) map onto the registry by tags; see ecs-architecture.md section 4.3.
